source_provenance_caution: Installed SonoBus1.7.3/build90 and matching public source labels do not prove installed binary hash/source configuration; do not infer runtime settings/channel masks from public defaults.
interpretation_limits: Clean controls establish a working alternate application/configuration on tested hardware; they do not isolate ownership of the fault.
SonoBus256 differs from SmartGrid512; Drambo callback size unobserved. All apps lack equivalent workload/MIDI/GUI/native callback instrumentation except desktop SmartGrid.
Thermal state is absent from control callback traces because those apps were not instrumented; absence of system pressure entries is not nominal.
Private mTLL/kernel thermal-level values are not NSProcessInfo enum values and cannot be relabelled fair/serious.

Charging properties disagree in service meaning: external connection, charger route state, battery current flow and PowerUIAgent policy state are separate. No instantaneous current measurement is inferred from a Boolean.
Session changes also reset/renegotiate USB audio; temporal/order and drift-state effects can accompany application changes. Prior short SmartGrid clean runs establish intermittency.

Hotter/lower-load/charging-complete controls, scheduler or DVFS policy, buffer size and channel/session topology remain plausible effect modifiers. Hub/MAYA temperature and rail stability were not measured.

Parent latest cooled-repeat evidence has21 failures including3after serious, with battery charging already off before all21; serious is not universally protective and charging cessation did not coincide with serious transition.
